definitions.explanation: The academic department or faculty at a university that teaches economics and related subjects.

examples.japanese: {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I entered the faculty of economics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧だ。
examples.english: My older sister is a third-year student in the economics department.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This university's economics faculty is famous for its research in international economics.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧ (economics) and {学部|がくぶ} (faculty/department). Japanese universities are organized into {学部|がくぶ}, which are larger divisions than individual departments. Asking someone's {学部|がくぶ} is a standard part of self-introduction among university students.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{所属|しょぞく}→所属：12750_shozoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to belong to the economics faculty
- {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to graduate from the economics faculty
- {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧: economics student

OTHER {学部|がくぶ} NAMES:
- ⟦{法学部|ほうがくぶ}→法学部：24334_hougakubu⟧: faculty of law
- ⟦{文学部|ぶんがくぶ}→文学部：24048_bungakubu⟧: faculty of literature/humanities
- ⟦{理学部|りがくぶ}→理学部：24492_rigakubu⟧: faculty of science
- ⟦{工学部|こうがくぶ}→工学部：24493_kougakubu⟧: faculty of engineering
- ⟦{医学部|いがくぶ}→医学部：27620_igakubu⟧: faculty of medicine
